declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: L1 (docs/rewrite-plan.md §4.2): only shell/ may use position:fixed/sticky or vh/dvh/svh/lvh units — everything else flows or reads --vvh.

at-rule-disallowed-list.message: L7: @media is banned outside shell/ and ui/ — primitives respond via container queries, not per-screen breakpoints.

scale-unlimited/declaration-strict-value.message: L3 (docs/rewrite-plan.md §4.2): colour, spacing, radius, font-size, shadow and duration come from tokens (var(--...)) only — no raw px/hex/ms in ui/ or features/. (#fff is allowed: text/icons drawn over a photographic cover's scrim are white regardless of theme, by design — not a themeable surface colour.)
